texts.Name: Anton Dziatkovskii
texts.In 3-5 sentences, describe an example: At Platinum Software Development Company (co-founder, 2015-now) I owned pre-sales for enterprise clients, including advisory work for subsidiaries of Foxconn and ANA Airlines. My derisking approach: a scoped discovery phase first, mapping the client's existing process before proposing changes, then splitting the Statement of Work into staged milestones so the prospect commits to a small first phase rather than a big-bang contract. My implementation roots are 5 years of Salesforce and Microsoft Navision ERP/CRM projects at Merlion, so I align the rollout with the daily workflow of the operators who will live in the system - the CRM we built for our own deal-flow ran with up to 30 daily operators for years. That staged-scoping-plus-process-alignment approach is what converted cautious enterprise prospects into long-term clients and kept the systems in production.
